in_marathi.name: Simant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Simant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Simhant' meaning 'mountain', or 'Simha' meaning 'lion'. The name is associated with the strength and courage of a mountain and the fierce power of a lion.
